title: VFR flight weather: METAR, TAF, SIGMET and VMC minima
summary: A VFR flight is planned against visual meteorological condition minima at each aerodrome when it is used and along the route. Observations (METAR) say now; forecasts (TAF, with prevailing and temporary change groups; SIGMET for hazards in a FIR) say later.

concepts.label: Flight
concepts.description: A VFR flight from a departure to a destination aerodrome at a planned time.

children.label: Aerodrome
children.description: An airport with an ICAO code; departure, destination or alternate.

children.label: Route
children.description: The great circle from departure to destination; distance, time en route.

children.label: Flight Information Region (FIR)
children.description: The airspace a SIGMET is issued for; Sweden is ESAA.

concepts.label: METAR
concepts.description: Routine aerodrome observation, usually every 30 min in Sweden.

facts.text: METAR visibility 9999 means 10 km or more; NOAA's JSON gives it in statute miles with a '+'.

concepts.label: TAF
concepts.description: Terminal aerodrome forecast, 9 to 30 h, in change groups.

children.label: Prevailing group (BASE, FM, BECMG)
children.description: What is expected; BECMG changes gradually between its two times.

children.label: Temporary group (TEMPO, PROB30/40)
children.description: Fluctuations for less than half the period, or a 30/40% chance; lists only what changes.

concepts.label: SIGMET
concepts.description: Warning of en-route hazards (thunderstorms, icing, turbulence, volcanic ash) for a FIR.

concepts.label: AIRMET
concepts.description: Lower-level hazards for light aircraft; issued in Europe per FIR, not in NOAA's international feed.

concepts.label: Ceiling
concepts.description: Height of the lowest BKN or OVC layer, or vertical visibility (ft above the aerodrome).

concepts.label: Flight category
concepts.description: VFR, MVFR, IFR, LIFR from ceiling and visibility (US convention, AWC's colours).

concepts.label: VMC minima
concepts.description: SERA visual meteorological condition minima; 1500 ft and 5 km at a controlled aerodrome, special VFR 600 ft and 1500 m.

facts.text: SERA.5005(b): VFR flights shall not take off or land at an aerodrome within a control zone when the ceiling is below 1500 ft or the ground visibility below 5 km.

concepts.label: Numerical weather forecast
concepts.description: SMHI's model (snow1g) at points on the route: cloud base, cover, visibility, gusts, precipitation, thunder.

concepts.label: NOTAM
concepts.description: Notices to airmen: closed runways, restricted areas. Not in this data.

concepts.label: Winds and temperatures aloft
concepts.description: Wind at cruise level for ground speed and drift. Not in this data: no wind is applied.

concepts.label: Icing and freezing level
concepts.description: In cloud or precipitation below 0 °C; matters in November. Only the frozen share of precipitation is here.
